title: The Eighth: Chaos Star and the Ouranian Serpent
summary: A chaos working of the magical personality. The Chaos Star is drawn before you, the seven planets circle you, and beyond them the sky splits and the octarine serpent of the eighth pours through.
source: Original to Virtual Rites, written in the spirit of the Ouranos concept in Peter J. Carroll's chaos magic. None of Carroll's ritual text is reproduced.

steps.title: Arrive
steps.text: Stand facing East. Let the everyday self go quiet, the one with errands and a name. Something else will stand here soon.
steps.say: Arrive. Let the everyday self go quiet.
steps.describe: A faint violet circle glows on the ground around you.

steps.title: Breathe
steps.text: Breathe with the ring. In as it widens, out as it narrows. Loosen your grip on who you think you are.
steps.describe: A pale ring on the ground widens and narrows slowly.

steps.title: The Chaos Star
steps.text: Point before you. From a single center, eight arrows of octarine fire burst outward, every direction at once.
steps.describe: An eight-pointed star of arrows is drawn in the air in front of you, each arrow a different shifting color.

steps.title: Kaos
steps.text: Vibrate the word into the heart of the star until the whole space hums with it.
steps.describe: The star flares and its arrows shimmer.

steps.title: Saturn
steps.text: The first of the seven rises and begins to circle you: the boundary, the long patience, the weight of time.
steps.describe: A dark indigo sphere appears above you and begins to orbit.

steps.title: Jupiter
steps.text: The expanse and the crown, generous and ruling.
steps.describe: A blue sphere joins the orbit.

steps.title: Mars
steps.text: The edge and the will to strike.
steps.describe: A red sphere joins the orbit.

steps.title: Sun
steps.text: The center and the shining self that everyone can see.
steps.describe: A golden sphere joins the orbit.

steps.title: Venus
steps.text: The bond and the delight.
steps.describe: A green sphere joins the orbit.

steps.title: Mercury
steps.text: The quick mind, the trick and the crossing.
steps.describe: An orange sphere joins the orbit.

steps.title: Moon
steps.text: The dream and the tide. Now all seven turn around you: every god you have ever worn.
steps.describe: A silver sphere completes the ring of seven, all circling you.

steps.title: Beyond the seven
steps.text: Past the last orbit, behind the star, something waits that none of the seven contain. A dark sun, burning at its edges.
steps.describe: Far behind the Chaos Star a black sphere rises with a shifting, many-colored corona.

steps.title: The rift opens
steps.text: Look up. The sky splits along a line of octarine light, and the serpent of the eighth pours through, coiling overhead.
steps.describe: Above you a glowing tear opens in the sky and a long shimmering serpent of shifting color flows out of it, stretching from East to West overhead.

steps.title: Ou-ra-nos
steps.text: Chant the barbarous words and let meaning fall away: OU-RA-NOS · ZA-KA-RETH · I-O-NAR · KHAL-A-THU. Again, faster, until the words are only sound.
steps.describe: The serpent writhes faster and brighter, and the seven planets speed up around you.

steps.title: Stand as the eighth
steps.text: You are not any of the seven. You are the one whose orbit holds them all: the one who wanted to be a magician in the first place. Let that personality stand up in you.
steps.describe: The serpent coils overhead and the dark sun's corona swells.

steps.title: Remain
steps.text: Stay as long as it holds. Notice what this one wants, how it moves, what it would dare. Mark anything that surfaces.

steps.title: The serpent returns
steps.text: Thank the eighth. The serpent draws back through the rift, and the tear in the sky seals.
steps.describe: The serpent withdraws into the glowing tear, which fades.

steps.title: The seven go home
steps.text: The planets slow, rise and fade back into their spheres. The dark sun sinks beyond sight.
steps.describe: The planets rise away and fade, and the black sphere shrinks to nothing.

steps.title: Laugh
steps.text: Laugh out loud. Whatever woke up goes back to its place outside the orbit. The Chaos Star flares once and is gone.
steps.describe: The Chaos Star flares and fades, and sparks scatter from the center.

steps.title: Return
steps.text: You are yourself again. Touch the floor, eat or drink something, and write in the journal, especially anything that felt unlike you.
